Coram : B.S. CHAUHAN, JASTI CHELAMESWAR
A B FAMILY LAW: Institution of marriage - In the impugned order, the High Court made observation that a valid marriage does not necessarily mean that all the customary rights C pertaining to the married couple at:e to be followed and subsequently solemnized - Instant SLP filed by Advocate not Such observations had been made in the facts of that case - In fact, the High Court observed that if a man and D woman are living together for a long time as husband and wife, though never married, there would be a presumption of marriage and their children could not be called illegitimate - High
